title: WHAT IF YOU WERE IMMORTAL? ⏳🌌 (Animated Short Film)
description:
At age twenty-five, an anomalous cellular mutation freezes Pip's biological clock forever. Zero sickness. Zero aging. Zero pain. When a stray robbery bullet strikes his forehead, the lead flattens like a coin and drops to the pavement. Pip smiles—he is invulnerable. He is a god. But immortality does not mean invincibility from time.

For three hundred years, life is an endless triumph. Pip masters sixteen languages, amasses thirty billion dollars in compound interest, and watches empires rise and fall like waves. But slowly... the world begins to change.

In century five, the curse reveals its teeth. Every woman he loves grows old and dies in his arms. His children, his grandchildren, and his dearest friends all turn to dust while his face remains twenty-five. By year 3000, wars and climate collapse strip Earth of its atmosphere, leaving Pip walking through an eighty-billion-ton graveyard of concrete and ash.

Five billion years later, the dying Sun swells into a red giant and incinerates Earth into slag. Thrown into the cosmic vacuum, Pip's lungs starve for air that never comes. For three trillion years, he drifts frozen in the pitch-black void of deep space... until an ancient cosmic artifact appears with one final choice.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 THE ULTIMATE EXISTENTIAL DILEMMA:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
The glowing cosmic artifact offers Pip one final escape before the universe ends:
👉 Option A: "DRINK THE CURE — Return to Earth in prime era, live 80 normal years, and die peacefully with loved ones."
👉 Option B: "REMAIN IMMORTAL — Drift alone through the silent dark void until the next universe is born."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
